title: Floor plan, seating arrangement and guest assignment

gates.evidence: SeatingFloorPlan.css unified toolbar, zoom readout, segmented controls, inspector drawer, legend & walkway labels onto --ui-theme-* tokens; color-contrast violations reduced from 3 dark / 1 light before edit to 0 after edit across all 8 scenes

gates.title: Keyboard, numeric positioning & mobile task-tab parity
gates.evidence: Arrow/Shift+Arrow movement, X/Y coordinate fieldset, and mobile Tables/Assign/Floor plan tabs verified across 390px-1440px (0px overflow) and seatingAccessibility.test.jsx (3/3 tests)

gates.title: MANAGE_SEATING RBAC permission gating & non-blocking confirmations
